examples.prompt: Provide the non-compliance report for April 2026
examples.business_meaning: List employees whose KRA goals were not completed during a specific calendar month, filtered by target_date falling within that month

filters.active: u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1

examples.sql_pattern: SELECT CONCAT(TRIM(u.firstname),' ',TRIM(u.lastname),' (',u.employee_id,')') AS employee, d.designation_name, u.stream AS department, mg.goal_desc AS goal_name, s.status_name AS goal_status, ugm.target_date FROM user_goal_mapping ugm JOIN user_table u ON ugm.employee_id = u.employee_id JOIN designation d ON u.designation_id = d.designation_id JOIN master_goals mg ON ugm.goal_id = mg.goal_id LEFT JOIN status s ON ugm.status_id = s.id WHERE u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1 AND s.status_name != 'Completed' AND YEAR(ugm.target_date) = 2026 AND MONTH(ugm.target_date) = 4 ORDER BY u.stream, u.firstname

examples.prompt: Provide the non-compliance report for April 2026, categorized department-wise
examples.business_meaning: Count of non-compliant employees and incomplete goals per department (u.stream) for a specific month — aggregate summary grouped by stream

filters.grouping: GROUP BY u.stream ORDER BY non_compliant_employees DESC

examples.sql_pattern: SELECT u.stream AS department, COUNT(DISTINCT ugm.employee_id) AS non_compliant_employees, COUNT(ugm.id) AS incomplete_goals FROM user_goal_mapping ugm JOIN user_table u ON ugm.employee_id = u.employee_id JOIN designation d ON u.designation_id = d.designation_id JOIN master_goals mg ON ugm.goal_id = mg.goal_id LEFT JOIN status s ON ugm.status_id = s.id WHERE u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1 AND s.status_name != 'Completed' AND YEAR(ugm.target_date) = 2026 AND MONTH(ugm.target_date) = 4 GROUP BY u.stream ORDER BY non_compliant_employees DESC

examples.prompt: Share the feedback report for 2026, including inputs from the employee, reporting manager, and HR
examples.business_meaning: KRA goals with manager feedback from remarks_table, employee self-assessment from remarks_threads, and reporting manager name — filtered by year of assigned_date

filters.active: u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1

examples.sql_pattern: SELECT CONCAT(TRIM(u.firstname),' ',TRIM(u.lastname),' (',u.employee_id,')') AS employee, d.designation_name, mg.goal_desc AS goal_name, ugm.goal_desc AS custom_goal, s.status_name AS goal_status, ugm.target_date, ugm.assigned_date, rt.remarks AS manager_feedback, CONCAT(TRIM(m.firstname),' ',TRIM(m.lastname)) AS feedback_given_by, r.remark_text AS employee_feedback, CONCAT(TRIM(mgr.firstname),' ',TRIM(mgr.lastname)) AS reporting_manager FROM user_goal_mapping ugm JOIN user_table u ON ugm.employee_id = u.employee_id JOIN designation d ON u.designation_id = d.designation_id JOIN master_goals mg ON ugm.goal_id = mg.goal_id LEFT JOIN status s ON ugm.status_id = s.id LEFT JOIN remarks_table rt ON ugm.goal_id = rt.goal_id LEFT JOIN user_table m ON rt.given_by = m.employee_id LEFT JOIN remarks_threads r ON r.goal_id = ugm.goal_id LEFT JOIN user_table mgr ON u.reporting_manager = mgr.employee_id WHERE u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1 AND YEAR(ugm.assigned_date) = 2026 ORDER BY u.firstname

examples.prompt: Provide the KRA report for the past 1 year for Baskar
examples.business_meaning: Full KRA report for a specific employee matched by first name — goals, manager feedback, employee feedback, reporting manager — last 1 year by target_date
examples.sql_pattern: SELECT CONCAT(TRIM(u.firstname),' ',TRIM(u.lastname),' (',u.employee_id,')') AS employee, d.designation_name, mg.goal_desc AS goal_name, ugm.goal_desc AS custom_goal, s.status_name AS goal_status, ugm.target_date, ugm.assigned_date, rt.remarks AS manager_feedback, CONCAT(TRIM(m.firstname),' ',TRIM(m.lastname)) AS feedback_given_by, r.remark_text AS employee_feedback, CONCAT(TRIM(mgr.firstname),' ',TRIM(mgr.lastname)) AS reporting_manager FROM user_goal_mapping ugm JOIN user_table u ON ugm.employee_id = u.employee_id JOIN designation d ON u.designation_id = d.designation_id JOIN master_goals mg ON ugm.goal_id = mg.goal_id LEFT JOIN status s ON ugm.status_id = s.id LEFT JOIN remarks_table rt ON ugm.goal_id = rt.goal_id LEFT JOIN user_table m ON rt.given_by = m.employee_id LEFT JOIN remarks_threads r ON r.goal_id = ugm.goal_id LEFT JOIN user_table mgr ON u.reporting_manager = mgr.employee_id WHERE u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1 AND u.firstname LIKE '%Baskar%' AND ugm.target_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) ORDER BY ugm.target_date

examples.prompt: Provide the report for the past 1 year for employee ID VT136
examples.business_meaning: Full KRA report for a specific employee looked up by exact employee_id — goals, manager feedback, employee feedback, reporting manager — last 1 year by target_date
examples.sql_pattern: SELECT CONCAT(TRIM(u.firstname),' ',TRIM(u.lastname),' (',u.employee_id,')') AS employee, d.designation_name, mg.goal_desc AS goal_name, ugm.goal_desc AS custom_goal, s.status_name AS goal_status, ugm.target_date, ugm.assigned_date, rt.remarks AS manager_feedback, CONCAT(TRIM(m.firstname),' ',TRIM(m.lastname)) AS feedback_given_by, r.remark_text AS employee_feedback, CONCAT(TRIM(mgr.firstname),' ',TRIM(mgr.lastname)) AS reporting_manager FROM user_goal_mapping ugm JOIN user_table u ON ugm.employee_id = u.employee_id JOIN designation d ON u.designation_id = d.designation_id JOIN master_goals mg ON ugm.goal_id = mg.goal_id LEFT JOIN status s ON ugm.status_id = s.id LEFT JOIN remarks_table rt ON ugm.goal_id = rt.goal_id LEFT JOIN user_table m ON rt.given_by = m.employee_id LEFT JOIN remarks_threads r ON r.goal_id = ugm.goal_id LEFT JOIN user_table mgr ON u.reporting_manager = mgr.employee_id WHERE u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1 AND u.employee_id = 'VT136' AND ugm.target_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) ORDER BY ugm.target_date

examples.prompt: List all employees who directly report to Jerome
examples.business_meaning: Employees whose reporting_manager resolves to a named manager — self-join on user_table to match manager by first or last name
examples.sql_pattern: SELECT CONCAT(TRIM(u.firstname),' ',TRIM(u.lastname),' (',u.employee_id,')') AS employee, d.designation_name, u.stream, u.e_mail, CONCAT(TRIM(mgr.firstname),' ',TRIM(mgr.lastname)) AS reporting_manager FROM user_table u JOIN designation d ON u.designation_id = d.designation_id JOIN user_table mgr ON u.reporting_manager = mgr.employee_id WHERE u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND d.is_active=1 AND (mgr.firstname LIKE '%Jerome%' OR mgr.lastname LIKE '%Jerome%') ORDER BY u.firstname

examples.prompt: List employees who have not been reviewed in the last 6 months
examples.business_meaning: Employees with no manager remarks (remarks_table) in the past 6 months — LEFT JOIN with date-bounded ON clause, HAVING last_reviewed_at IS NULL
joins: remarks_table rt ON u.employee_id = rt.user_id AND rt.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
examples.sql_pattern: SELECT CONCAT(TRIM(u.firstname),' ',TRIM(u.lastname),' (',u.employee_id,')') AS employee, d.designation_name, u.stream, MAX(rt.created_at) AS last_reviewed_at FROM user_table u JOIN designation d ON u.designation_id = d.designation_id LEFT JOIN remarks_table rt ON u.employee_id = rt.user_id AND rt.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) WHERE u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND d.is_active=1 GROUP BY u.employee_id, u.firstname, u.lastname, d.designation_name, u.stream HAVING last_reviewed_at IS NULL ORDER BY u.stream, u.firstname

examples.prompt: Provide the last 1 year report for employee ID VT136, including feedback, compliance, and KRA details
examples.business_meaning: Complete KRA summary for a given employee_id — goals, performance_rating, manager feedback, employee self-assessment, compliance status, reporting manager — last 1 year
examples.sql_pattern: SELECT CONCAT(TRIM(u.firstname),' ',TRIM(u.lastname),' (',u.employee_id,')') AS employee, d.designation_name, mg.goal_desc AS goal_name, ugm.goal_desc AS custom_goal, s.status_name AS goal_status, ugm.target_date, ugm.assigned_date, rt.remarks AS manager_feedback, rt.performance_rating, CONCAT(TRIM(m.firstname),' ',TRIM(m.lastname)) AS feedback_given_by, r.remark_text AS employee_feedback, CONCAT(TRIM(mgr.firstname),' ',TRIM(mgr.lastname)) AS reporting_manager FROM user_goal_mapping ugm JOIN user_table u ON ugm.employee_id = u.employee_id JOIN designation d ON u.designation_id = d.designation_id JOIN master_goals mg ON ugm.goal_id = mg.goal_id LEFT JOIN status s ON ugm.status_id = s.id LEFT JOIN remarks_table rt ON ugm.goal_id = rt.goal_id LEFT JOIN user_table m ON rt.given_by = m.employee_id LEFT JOIN remarks_threads r ON r.goal_id = ugm.goal_id LEFT JOIN user_table mgr ON u.reporting_manager = mgr.employee_id WHERE u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1 AND u.employee_id = 'VT136' AND ugm.target_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) ORDER BY ugm.target_date

examples.prompt: List all KRA goals assigned to employees
examples.business_meaning: All active KRA goal assignments per employee — one row per goal, no aggregation, with goal description, status, target date, and assigned date

filters.active: u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1

examples.sql_pattern: SELECT CONCAT(TRIM(u.firstname),' ',TRIM(u.lastname),' (',u.employee_id,')') AS employee, d.designation_name, mg.goal_desc AS goal_name, ugm.goal_desc AS custom_goal, s.status_name AS goal_status, ugm.target_date, ugm.assigned_date FROM user_goal_mapping ugm JOIN user_table u ON ugm.employee_id = u.employee_id JOIN designation d ON u.designation_id = d.designation_id JOIN master_goals mg ON ugm.goal_id = mg.goal_id LEFT JOIN status s ON ugm.status_id = s.id WHERE u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1 ORDER BY u.firstname, ugm.target_date

examples.prompt: Show compliance report — employees who completed their KRA goals this year
examples.business_meaning: Count of employees and completed goals per department (u.stream) where status = Completed — department-wise compliance aggregate

filters.grouping: GROUP BY u.stream ORDER BY compliant_employees DESC

examples.sql_pattern: SELECT u.stream AS department, COUNT(DISTINCT ugm.employee_id) AS compliant_employees, COUNT(ugm.id) AS completed_goals FROM user_goal_mapping ugm JOIN user_table u ON ugm.employee_id = u.employee_id JOIN designation d ON u.designation_id = d.designation_id JOIN master_goals mg ON ugm.goal_id = mg.goal_id LEFT JOIN status s ON ugm.status_id = s.id WHERE u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1 AND s.status_name = 'Completed' GROUP BY u.stream ORDER BY compliant_employees DESC

examples.prompt: Show KRA report grouped by manager — list all goals under each manager
examples.business_meaning: KRA goals with reporting_manager as the first/leading column — manager-first view showing all employees and goals under each manager, self-join on user_table for manager display name

filters.active: u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1

examples.sql_pattern: SELECT CONCAT(TRIM(mgr.firstname),' ',TRIM(mgr.lastname)) AS reporting_manager, CONCAT(TRIM(u.firstname),' ',TRIM(u.lastname),' (',u.employee_id,')') AS employee, d.designation_name, u.stream AS department, mg.goal_desc AS goal_name, s.status_name AS goal_status, ugm.target_date, ugm.assigned_date FROM user_goal_mapping ugm JOIN user_table u ON ugm.employee_id = u.employee_id JOIN designation d ON u.designation_id = d.designation_id JOIN master_goals mg ON ugm.goal_id = mg.goal_id LEFT JOIN status s ON ugm.status_id = s.id LEFT JOIN user_table mgr ON u.reporting_manager = mgr.employee_id WHERE u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1 ORDER BY reporting_manager, u.firstname

examples.prompt: Show KRA goals pending approval — goals submitted but not yet actioned
examples.business_meaning: KRA goals in a pending state — assigned_by (approver) as first column, then reporting_manager, to show the full approval chain

filters.active: u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1

examples.sql_pattern: SELECT CONCAT(TRIM(assigner.firstname),' ',TRIM(assigner.lastname)) AS assigned_by, CONCAT(TRIM(mgr.firstname),' ',TRIM(mgr.lastname)) AS reporting_manager, CONCAT(TRIM(u.firstname),' ',TRIM(u.lastname),' (',u.employee_id,')') AS employee, d.designation_name, u.stream AS department, mg.goal_desc AS goal_name, s.status_name AS goal_status, ugm.target_date, ugm.assigned_date FROM user_goal_mapping ugm JOIN user_table u ON ugm.employee_id = u.employee_id JOIN designation d ON u.designation_id = d.designation_id JOIN master_goals mg ON ugm.goal_id = mg.goal_id LEFT JOIN status s ON ugm.status_id = s.id LEFT JOIN user_table assigner ON ugm.assigned_by = assigner.employee_id LEFT JOIN user_table mgr ON u.reporting_manager = mgr.employee_id WHERE u.is_active=1 AND u.is_delete=0 AND ugm.isDelete=0 AND ugm.isactive=1 AND d.is_active=1 AND s.status_name LIKE '%Pending%' ORDER BY assigned_by, u.firstname
